name: Kaiun Sentai Miko-san Ranger Revenge
original_name: 開運戦隊 巫女サンレンジャーりべんじ
source:
"Seifuku Master" organization is dismissed, and colonel An-an travels to a foreign country to wrap things up there. At that time one of the Miko-san Rangers attacks the base to avenge her comrades. "Seifuku Master" gets hastily restored, and the new spiral of confrontation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“制服大师”组织被解散，安安上校前往国外处理善后。此时，一名巫女战士为了替同伴报仇，袭击了基地。“制服大师”被仓促重建，新一轮的对抗就此展开。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-january-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
